point.title: Generation Evaluation Workbench
point.rationale: Evaluation runs pin prompts, contexts, canvas inputs, and output provenance across workflows and repeated samples. Comparisons capture independent snapshots; experiments organize conditions and attempts; judgements preserve typed assessments. Completed outputs can be promoted through the same catalog publication boundary, making this a substantial product subsystem rather than test infrastructure.
